profile.headline: Software Engineer at Colliers
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
✲ Full stack software engineer experienced in building scalable applications and developer tools with JavaScript, React, Node/Express, and Typescript

✲ Passionate about developing effective solutions and building cool things to make life easier :)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Utilized Electron to bundle React, Chromium, and Node.js packages to access and manipulate native system resources such as file systems and network sockets with APIs, and enable cross-platform functionality across Windows, macOS, and Linux

• Implemented React’s unidirectional data flow model and React Hooks to create reusable stateful components for dynamic DOM management

• Utilized the React Flow library to create an intuitive Graphical User Interface (GUI) database visualizer, providing flexible API for customization of stateful node-based architecture and dynamic rendering

• Integrated TypeScript to optimize the development process by ensuring static typing and type safety, and allowing efficient codebase scalability and readability which resulted in a decrease in runtime errors and improved code efficiency

• Deployed TDD practices with Jest and Enzyme testing suites to catch early design flaws and protect against regression bugs and edge cases

• Debugged Faker.js library mock data generation issues by diagnosing errors in Electron event emitters and IPC handlers, updating middleware stack, and adjusting routing for efficient front-end to back-end communication

• Implemented PostgreSQL and MySQL Node clients to abstract SQL functions, enabling backend model standardization for optimizing data analytics, modeling, and storage techniques connecting to frontend components and schema relationships

• Utilized AWS Beanstalk for deploying and scaling website application to streamline routing, reliability, and security

• SeeQR is an open-source product maintained by the tech accelerator, OSLabs (opensourcelabs.io)

positions.title: Design Engineer, Design Lead
positions.description:
• Developed and implemented hydraulic design calculators by utilizing function writing and algorithmic problem solving to analyze and synthesize GIS and field data, resulting in an effective and scalable solution utilized across multiple projects

• Designed visual design models using CAD software to identify potential design flaws and streamline the development process by breaking down projects into manageable pieces, and identifying key variables that impact the overall site layout

• Managed daily cross-team coordination and design direction to effectively communicate data analysis, technical concepts, and summarized recommendations and reports to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and team members

• Implemented Agile/SCRUM methodology to manage day-to-day technical design direction and delegate tasks

projects.title: HappyPlants | Plant health and metrics tracking tool
projects.description:
• Developed a comprehensive plant health and metrics tracking tool leveraging React.js for the frontend and Node.js for the backend, ensuring an intuitive and efficient user experience.

• Established a NoSQL database with MongoDB to store non relational data, allowing users the capability to add specific information pertaining to the defined plant within library

• Implemented React Hooks to optimize state management, handling component behavior and logic to update plant health information upon watering schedules, revival, and warning indicators

projects.title: Thresh | Collaborative Kanban Board Application
projects.description:
• Employed Node.js/Express to leverage asynchronous architecture and middleware design patterns, enabling a more readable, modular, and streamlined backend that handles RESTful API request routing between client and SQL database endpoints

• Implemented a SQL database to store relational data and optimize complex relationships between boards and task details, providing strong data consistency and ACID compliance on transactions to ensure data is properly stored and retrievable

• Utilized React Router to handle client-side routing and minimize server-side requests, providing an intuitive way to manage and navigate between pages, preserving the state of the UI, and ensuring clean and organized dynamic navigation

• Incorporated React-Beautiful-DND drag and drop functionality to enable movement of project management tasks between lists and within nested lists for a clear and efficient UI experience while maintaining compatibility with server-side rendering

• Integrated OAuth by creating user logins and access tokens for secure and industry-standard authentication and authorization, linking user information to corresponding project task boards through the use of cookie and session ID management
